difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a surjection of sheaves of sets is the coequalizer of the two projections from the fibre product of the map with itself (statement lines 2485-2499). The proof is a complete argument: given a map equalizing the two projections, the author forms the presheaf image of the given map and uses that the fibre product is computed in presheaves to obtain a unique induced map on that presheaf image (proof lines 2502-2510); since the target is the sheafification of that presheaf image, the induced map extends uniquely to the target, which gives the factorisation (proof lines 2511-2514); and the author records that the verification of the identity of the composite is omitted (proof lines 2514-2515), a routine check preserved verbatim in the counted span. The non-formal content is the reduction to the presheaf image. The claim is H2: a structured argument with the closing verification noted.
